policy: Narrow aliases group the same operator action while retaining every source variant. Broader candidate aliases are navigation relationships only. No group establishes that one vendor satisfies another vendor's conditions.

approved_alias_groups.reason: Change quantity before payment; item-configuration versus cart-row interaction remains a documented variant.
Complete one sale through multiple tender amounts. Square timeout and Shopify partial-collection variants remain separate requirements.
Choose receipt delivery at payment completion. Available channels, identity reuse and privacy qualifications are retained.
Duplicate Shopify documentation of customer access to the published policy through the checkout display.
Same Toast device mode transition; trigger and timing boundaries are retained.
Define fixed sellable variants with per-variant data. Product-level creation and nested menu modifiers remain separate.
Receive transferred inventory at the destination. Partial quantities, rejection and stock effects remain vendor-specific.
Create a physical retail location; initial stock and plan qualifications remain attached to each claim.
BTCPay predefined store-role assignment across user and API documentation; this grants no implied wallet signing authority.
Enter tendered cash and calculate change. Square's broader record-only tender claim is related but not equivalent.

not_combined: Tip configuration, tip collection, and tip refunds are separate actions.
Split by seat, split an item, split a bill, and split tender preserve different allocation and recovery rules.
Catalog CSV import and export remain separate obligations even where a source claim documents both.
Full counts, cycle counts, manual adjustments, and restaurant availability quantities are not interchangeable.
Cash-drawer configuration, opening float, pay-in, pay-out, count, close, and deposit reporting are not interchangeable.
Offline card acceptance, upload deadlines, status display, and reconciliation are distinct obligations.
Public-only observation is a security objective. Generating and deleting a server key is one mechanism, not proof of a safe OpenBMT pairing workflow.

retired_duplicate_claims.reason: Author consolidated duplicate cash-drawer history claim into the fuller existing claim before final freeze. Coverage references now use SQO-C010.
